symptom: ako/mxcli#2004 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1771): on a fresh clone `mxcli search -p app.mpr SUB_Do` printed "No matches found." and exited 0 for a microflow called from another flow's body; `callers`/`refs` found it. Only after `refresh catalog full source` did search see bodies.
cause: search ensured only a FULL catalog (strings + documentation); CATALOG.SOURCE exists only in source mode, which nothing built implicitly, so the source half of every search was empty and the only signal was a stderr warning.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_catalog.go (ensureSearchCatalog: build source mode when missing, announced once; SearchOptions.NoBuild / SearchOutcome.Incomplete), cmd/mxcli/cmd_query.go (--no-build, searchExitCode: 3 when incomplete, 1 for a --fail-on-match hit), cmd/mxcli/main.go (flag)
insight: Decide build-on-demand from measurement, not fear: on TestApp the cold source build costs ~4.1 s vs 2.9 s for full, an unchanged rerun 0.07 s, and a rebuild after one microflow edit 0.48 s, because CATALOG.SOURCE reuse (#1790) carries unchanged documents over. Upgrading full -> source is a full rebuild, so the one-time cost is announced. Keep an opt-out that turns 'could not look' into a distinct exit code (3) rather than a JSON shape change: --json stays a bare array for existing consumers, and 1/2 already mean match/error under --fail-on-match. Note: a test file named cmd_search_source_index_test.go already existed and was nearly overwritten — check before writing a test file by an obvious name.
